links.outcome: AI assistant performance on PGx question catalog, RAG-grounded GPT-4 versus ChatGPT 3.5
links.effect: RAG-based GPT-4 assistant performed better than ChatGPT 3.5, especially on provider-specific queries requiring specialized data and citations; no numeric results reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Compared with OpenAI’s ChatGPT 3.5, it demonstrated better performance, especially in provider-specific queries requiring specialized data and citations.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering and guardrails to tailor GPT-4 responses for pharmacogenomic queries

screen.reason: Evaluates a pharmacogenomics decision-support LLM using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and prompt guardrails against baseline ChatGPT-3.5 on a clinical question catalog.

primary.practice: retrieval augmented generation and prompt guardrails
